figma.pulledWith: Figma MCP get_design_context, one call per frame, symbols expanded by the tool. The unmodified code block of each call is committed under raw/; inventory.json is generated from those files and from nothing else.

expandedSymbols.1:99: Header — the navigation. A frame screenshot renders it as a flat picture; only the expansion carries its typography, logo colour and CTA. Missing this is how the whole nav went unchecked in Phase 4.
expandedSymbols.1:575: Footer — the dark symbol. Note it declares NO fill of its own, so the band a reader sees is the frame fill behind it.
expandedSymbols.1:606: btn_More — the pill used for More and, with the label overridden, Send.

textNodes.text: Cennso lets you deploy 5G anywhere: build MVNOs, travel SIM solutions, or private networks with seamless interoperability and centralized control.
Deployed in 170+ locations globally, Cennso delivers scalable network services for consumers and IoT on any Kubernetes platform: cloud, bare metal, or edge.
Built on 20+ years of telecom expertise, Cennso and its solution partners help you create custom network solutions.
Cennso's high-performance network functions maximize your hardware investment, reducing costs and operational complexity.
Managing 24+ billion user sessions annually, Cennso's horizontally scalable platform scales with your network demands.

Cennso enables you to run 5G networks in any location—from industrial sites to specialized facilities—with centralized management. Manage all distributed sites from one control plane, deploy high-performance configurations for low-latency applications, and automatically verify hardware compatibility remotely, without engineers onsite.

Cennso gives you the agility to expand virtual network services rapidly. Maintain stable subscriber sessions across regions and cloud providers, deploy high-performance core network functions or integrate your own through standard interfaces, and update configurations or launch new data plans with automated GitOps workflows.

Cennso delivers secure, dedicated 5G networks for factories, ports, and large campuses. Integrate with existing enterprise security and credential providers, deploy only the network functions your facility needs, and use Crossplane to unify on-site infrastructure with cloud services through a single workflow.
